Traits Signal

The Standing Rerolls granted by your Crescendo last 10 minutes instead of 1 minute. Everything else about Crescendo is unchanged: it still costs 1 action, still requires at least 5 Encore, still spends your entire pool, and still grants each ally in range exactly one Standing Reroll.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB2 — modifies the duration of a reroll-grant effect that itself cannot exist. No Reroll rule-element key exists anywhere in Foundry's pf2e system (confirmed: zero hits for "key": "Reroll" in pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/, and the full 34-entry rule-element key list has no reroll key -- RollTwice is a different, pre-result advantage/disadvantage mechanic). Encore's core primitive, "spend 1 Encore to reroll a failed check," is a post-result reroll and is categorically unbuildable as a standing rule element.
